title: fragaria nigra
intro: Fragaria nigra, commonly known as Black Raspberry or Black Cap, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation and pain due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria nigra are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
